caseName: International Business Machines Corp. v. United States
caseNameFull: International Business Machines Corp. v. United States
judges: Application, Blackmun, Consideration, Grant, Stewart, Took

opinions.text:
Application for stay of execution and enforcement of pretrial order No. 5 of the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York and for a stay of mandate of the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit presented to Mr. Justice Marshall, and by him referred to the Court, denied.

Mr. Justice Stewart, Mr. Justice Blackmun, and Mr. Justice Powell took no part in *946the consideration or decision of this application. Mr. Justice Douglas would grant the application.
